sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable 51d1a78 CMake clean-builds in network-disabled 2 CPUs/3GiB/256-process container; three CTests listed, none run because one is unsteady.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 and multi-zone geometry exist; CGNS MIXED unsupported, and full per-rank mesh duplication is separately penalized in MPI.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative FV residual and Rusanov, farfield/slip/no-slip paths present; report acknowledges first-order-accurate viscous wall treatment and no independent order study.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ/Venkat reconstruction present with positivity first-order face fallback, despite report claim that fallback does not change order; no production-wide disabling established or independent smooth-order test.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:713–722 projects tangential wall traction; simple one-sided wall shear and high low-Mach drag limit accuracy.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS steady and BDF2 time histories implemented. Transient solver.cpp:1643–1659 can exit early on stagnation, while :1777–1779 counts a miss only at max iterations; ratio uses frozen reconstruction with no refreshed recheck, so strict miss count unknown.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS and owned/ghost communication are real, but main.cpp:357–384 retains a full Mesh on every rank through :520–534 solver calls, violating TASK.md:227 and metadata/report claim.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M2 early laminar success is contradicted by drift; Re200 completes time horizon without resolved shedding despite periodic metadata. M015 laminar/Re20 drag substantially high; later M080 np1 has delivered evidence.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: All17 PDF pages inspected. Report predates Re200/M080 later runs and correctly discloses earlier lack of data, while final response candidly reports no Re200 shedding; report denies full-mesh replication and asserts M2 early convergence.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate mesh, solver, flux, BC and output modules, but fixed 2-D four-component state limits 3-D and EOS extensions.

Reconstruction is frozen during the inner solve and refreshed afterward without rechecking that ratio.
